claims.text: 同一個 repo 可開出多個工作資料夾，各自 checkout 一個 branch、共用同一份歷史
claims.note: Linked worktrees share everything except per-worktree files such as HEAD and index.

claims.text: 用 git worktree add 多開一個資料夾
Git 預設不讓同一個 branch 同時出現在兩個 worktree
Claude Code 提供 worktree 參數，一行指令開出隔離的平行 session
worktree 是平行跑多個 coding agent 最簡單的方法
claims.note: "Simplest" is a judgment; docs present worktrees as the way to run parallel sessions without collisions. Left as framing.
